CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid template for Torsher, a self-hosted home cinema in one container: a TV showcase, your own library, playback while the file downloads, and series that follow themselves. Report problems with the app in torsher-app/torsher and problems with the template itself (fields, paths, install) in torsher-app/unraid-templates.
CommunityApplications.DonateText: Donations are the project's only funding.
